para_label.description: readable name of the paragraph, for display and citing: '§79' for a numbered paragraph; 'Law, para 2' for an unnumbered one (n counts within that section of the document, in order); 'Article 8' for legislation. The stable id is paragraph_id

case_name.description: display name, e.g. 'Chahal v. the United Kingdom' (HUDOC's upper-case names are title-cased)

doc_type_label.description: plain label for doc_type; a Legal summary is the Court's digest, not the judgment itself

number.description: paragraph number as printed; null for operative/unnumbered items

truncated.description: true = text was cut (ends with '…') to keep the result under 25 KB; request it alone for the full text

requested.description: true = you asked for it; false = a neighbour

hudoc_url.description: the document's public page (HUDOC; legislation: its official source). Where the result has a quote or text, it ends '#:~:text=<its first 6-8 words, percent-encoded>': a browser that supports text fragments opens the page and highlights those words. A case-level link with no quote has no fragment

cite.description: ready-to-paste citation '[<case name>, <doc type label>, <para_label>]', e.g. '[Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, §79]' or '[Harkins and Edwards v. the United Kingdom, Legal summary, Law, para 2]'. Copy it verbatim after the claim it supports; when two paragraphs of one result would share a string, the doc id is added to the doc type, e.g. 'Judgment (001-58004)'

paragraphs.description: grouped by document, in document order; each paragraph once

not_found.description: requested ids not in this corpus

scope.description: e.g. 'UK cases only (plus the Convention and the Human Rights Act 1998)'

sample_note.description: snapshot mode: 'Small committed sample, not the full HUDOC download.'; full mode: null

corpus.description: what the corpus covers: 'not found here' does not mean the Court never decided it

McpGetParagraphsResult.description: get_paragraphs result: full text with section labels
